mn94:5.10: the individual who mortifies others, committed to the practice of mortifying others—I don’t like the sound of that individual either;
mn94:5.11: the individual who mortifies themselves and others, committed to the practice of mortifying themselves and others—I don’t like the sound of that individual either;
mn94:5.12: but the individual who doesn’t mortify either themselves or others, committed to the practice of not mortifying themselves or others—they live without wishes in this very life, quenched, cooled, experiencing bliss, with self become divine.
mn94:7.6: They live without wishes in this very life, quenched, cooled, experiencing bliss, with self become divine.
mn94:7.8: the group of people who, being obsessed with jeweled earrings, seeks partners and children, male and female bondservants, fields and lands, and gold and currency, or the group of people who, not being obsessed with jeweled earrings, has given up partner and children, male and female bondservants, fields and lands, and gold and currency, and goes forth from the lay life to homelessness?”
mn94:32.6: Worthy Udena, if I heard that the worthy Gotama was within twenty leagues …
mn94:32.9: fifty leagues, I’d go fifty leagues to see that worthy Gotama, the perfected one, the fully awakened Buddha.
mn94:32.10: If I heard that the worthy Gotama was a hundred leagues away, worthy Udena, I’d go a hundred leagues to see that worthy Gotama, the perfected one, the fully awakened Buddha.
